name: Related Skills
headline: Scroll Storyteller: Interactive Narratives
short_description: Scroll Storyteller allows users to craft engaging and interactive narratives using Anthropic's design principles. Ideal for storytellers and content creators looking to enhance their storytelling with animation and chapter-based structures.
author: ingpoc

sections.overview:
Scroll Storyteller enables creators to build immersive, interactive narratives using Anthropic's authentic design language—featuring strict duotone palettes, organic Bézier SVG illustrations, custom cursors, and chapter-based structures. The skill guides users through a structured workflow: selecting animation preferences (GSAP-powered or CSS-only), choosing mood and color palette, defining narrative chapters, and generating fully customizable scroll experiences. Each chapter alternates between light and dark sections with staggered reveals, parallax effects, and mouse-following spotlight layers. The tool includes topic-driven SVG templates for Biblical, Tech, Business, and Personal narratives, ensuring compositions match narrative position and symbolic intent. Built on IntersectionObserver for CSS-only mode or GSAP 3.x with ScrollTrigger for rich interactions, it's lightweight and performant for explainer pages, product showcases, and visual narratives.
Create interactive presentations or narratives for education.
Develop immersive stories for gaming or digital media.
Design engagement experiences for marketing campaigns.
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`$ npx skills add https://github.com/ingpoc/skills --skill scroll-storyteller`
`git clone https://github.com/ingpoc/skills`
sections.usage:
```
Create an interactive scroll-based story for [AUDIENCE] in the [GENRE] genre. Structure it in chapters with [NUMBER] sections per chapter. Include [THEME] as the central focus. Use [TONE] tone and incorporate [INTERACTIVE_ELEMENT] at the end of each chapter. The story should be [LENGTH] words long.
```
Copy

```
# **The Last Lightkeeper**
*A Scroll Story for Fantasy Lovers*
```
